senses.def: Used to indicate that different situations may produce different results.
It is not important; do not worry (used to reassure or comfort the person to whom it is said).
ex: I’m afraid I’ve broken your mug. – It doesn’t matter; it was old and I was going to throw it away anyway.

senses.def: I withdraw my previous statement (often used if it wasn't heard or understood).
ex: Maybe we could try fixing this part to the … no, wait, it doesn’t matter.
